1285|ed056522.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1286|ed056522.name: Edna Mullby
1286|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

14724|92b80d28.name: Bubulo Acerbus
14724|92b80d28.text:
The exiles of Gnomeregan find ourselves in even more dire straits by running low on cloth reserves!  Perhaps you can help us, eh?!

Bring me extra cloth pieces you might have to help us replenish our stocks.  By donating them, you'll be earning the respect and trust of gnomes everywhere.  That's something that money can't buy!  Well, I guess cloth does, but that's beside the point...

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

2367|837eac47.name: Donald Rabonne
2367|837eac47.text: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.

255877|837eac47.name: Hunter Moore
255877|837eac47.text: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.

5161|837eac47.name: Grimnur Stonebrand
5161|837eac47.text: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.

5515|08830bac.name: Einris Brightspear
5515|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5515|4a5716a3.name: Einris Brightspear
5515|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5564|30b7493c.name: Simon Tanner
5564|30b7493c.text: Sorry, but you've reached the limit of what I can teach. If you want to learn more, go see Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He's pretty talented, so I hear.

7944|9a62fac1.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
7944|9a62fac1.text:
I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!

Also, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

912|b02b9fad.name: Thran Khorman
912|b02b9fad.text: The big wars might be over, for now, but we still have to keep our skills sharp!

1078-accept.name: Collin Mauren
1078-accept.text:
Travelers keep asking me about the Stonetalon Mountains. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.

Within the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.

If those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.

Take your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.
1078-accept.title: Retrieval for Mauren

115-complete.name: Marshal Marris
115-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  I'll send these to be destroyed immediately.
115-complete.title: Shadow Magic

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

169-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
169-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N!  Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans.  Vindication is ours.  This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
169-complete.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

180-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-complete.text: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead?  Good riddance to that foul creature.  You are very brave, $c.  The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
180-complete.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

19-complete.name: Marshal Marris
19-complete.text: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc.  Well done--I'm sure he didn't go down easy.  Here is your reward, $N.
19-complete.title: Tharil'zun

19-progress.name: Marshal Marris
19-progress.text: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19-progress.title: Tharil'zun

226-complete.name: Lars
226-complete.text:
Oh good.  You thinned out that pack quite a bit, and without those wolves nipping out our heels, we can bind our minds to dealing with Morbent Fel.

Here, take some of these Flash Bundles.  They make them in town, and a lot have been donated to Sven to help with his cause.
226-complete.title: Wolves at Our Heels

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

248-complete.name: Unknown
248-complete.text: It is a suitable vessel for the Glyph of Azora, allowing Theocritus to delve into the minds within Stonewatch Keep.
248-complete.title: Looking Further

248-progress.name: Unknown
248-progress.text: This jar once held a foul-smelling liquor, but now lies empty and forgotten on a pair of barrels.
248-progress.title: Looking Further

249-accept.name: Unknown
249-accept.text:
After much observation, I have discovered Morganth's plans.

He searches for the Scythe of Elune...and he may have found it!  If he has, then the Redridge Mountains, and the kingdom of Stormwind, will soon feel his dark might.

I am not prepared to pit myself against Morganth, but I fear he must be dealt with now.  So you must enter the Tower of Ilgalar and face Morganth.

Defeat him, and bring me his Pendant of Shadow.  Do this, and the kingdom will owe you much.
249-accept.title: Morganth

249-complete.name: Theocritus
249-complete.text:
You have done well, $N.  In defeating the warlock Morganth, Stormwind is saved from a grave peril.

I offer you this reward most humbly.  And I would bid you peace, if these were peaceful times.

But instead, I will bid you luck with your trials, and victory in the conflicts ahead.
249-complete.title: Morganth

249-progress.name: Theocritus
249-progress.text: Hurry, $N, before my fears of Morganth spreading his power are made real!
249-progress.title: Morganth

276-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
276-complete.text: By reducing the gnolls' numbers, you have tended to the health of the Wetlands. Although my faith in your people has been taxed in the past, $r, it may yet be restored.
276-complete.title: Tramping Paws

277-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-accept.text:
The Mosshides are cutting the trees of the Wetlands, using the trees' flesh to warm themselves with fire. I will suffer this pain no longer!

Rid the Mosshides of their crude flints, the tools they use to make fire. The flints are borne by all Mosshides except the smaller Mosshide gnolls and Mosshide mongrels.
277-accept.title: Fire Taboo

2922-accept.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
2922-accept.text:
When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue spark must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot.  It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized.  Now it's negatronic... and Techbot's behaviors are reversed.  It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!

But perhaps it can be salvaged.  Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.
2922-accept.title: Save Techbot's Brain!

2923-complete.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
2923-complete.text: Yes it's true.  Techbot has gone rogue!  Please, can you help me?
2923-complete.title: Tinkmaster Overspark

2924-accept.name: Klockmort Spannerspan
2924-accept.text:
A nigh-universal mechanical component--the essential artificial--was of great use to the tinkers and smiths of Gnomeregan.  But during the frantic exodus from our city, no one remembered to take any of these devices with them!  And I need a large supply of them for work I will soon undertake.

Please, go into Gnomeregan and get me some essential artificials.  You'll find them in the deeper areas of our city, held in containers called artificial extrapolators.

Thank you, $N, and please hurry!
2924-accept.title: Essential Artificials

2926-accept.name: Ozzie Togglevolt
2926-accept.text:
Since the accident, all Gnoarn thinks about or talks about is cleansing Gnomeregan of the trogg infestation and finding a cure for the sickness that plagues it, $N.

Luckily, Razzle and I are close to some kind of cure - either that or the recipe for a really powerful rum. We won't know until we test! Naturally, in order to test our theory, we're going to need a few things; namely, fallout from the irradiated troggs in Gnomeregan. Fill up this phial with the green glow and bring it back!
2926-accept.title: Gnogaine

2927-accept.name: Gnoarn
2927-accept.text:
You don't think I was always bald, do you? No ma'am! It was the radiation leak in Gnomeregan that caused this tragic hair loss. Before that day, I had the only gnomefro in all of Azeroth.

<Gnoarn shakes his fist in the air.>

Damn those damned dirty troggs - damn them all!!

Perhaps it's not too late, $N. We may still be able to save it - the city I mean! Speak to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. He and his partner Razzle are working on a solution.
2927-accept.title: The Day After

2927-complete.name: Ozzie Togglevolt
2927-complete.text:
I thought the loss of that outstanding head of hair would have been the end of him for sure, but he survived!

I was standing right next to him when he was hit by the radiation bolt. Those delightful brown locks of hair hit the floor in clumps! Clusters! The horror of it all was only compounded when Gnoarn completely freaked out! Oh yes, freaked out I say! Gnoarn touched his bald head in disbelief, the look in his eyes screamed revenge, $N! Then he turned his anger towards the troggs!

<Ozzie cringes.>
2927-complete.title: The Day After

294-accept.name: Ormer Ironbraid
294-accept.text:
The situation is severe, that much is for sure. When we uncovered these bones it attracted the Raptors. These filthy beasts killed my brethren and trapped me, Merrin and the poor Prospector up here.

Help clear the Wetlands of these Raptors, $N. Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers are just West of the bluff there. Kill 10 of each, if you can.

That will be a good start to the vengeance I have planned for them.
294-accept.title: Ormer's Revenge

294-complete.name: Ormer Ironbraid
294-complete.text: Killing is a dirty business, but you did your job well, $N. If I weren't obligated to stay with the Prospector and Merrin, I'd be down there shedding blood right along side you.
294-complete.title: Ormer's Revenge

295-accept.name: Ormer Ironbraid
295-accept.text: Now it's time to really make those dreaded Raptors regret their blood-thirst. Just down below there are scores of Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws. Make those rotten creatures pay by slaying 10 of each!
295-accept.title: Ormer's Revenge

295-complete.name: Ormer Ironbraid
295-complete.text: You did a bang-up job of clearing out those raptors, $N!
295-complete.title: Ormer's Revenge

296-accept.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-accept.text:
While you were down there I happened to notice that one of those beasts stood out from the rest. He was bigger and more menacing. I bet he's the one who led the others here to cause the disruption to the dig site.

I ask of you now one final task, $N. See to it that Sarltooth is brought to justice. And considering the gravity of his crimes, justice in this case means death! Bring me one of his talons as proof of his death.
296-accept.title: Ormer's Revenge

296-complete.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-complete.text: Thank you, $N. Your efforts here will not be forgotten. Many innocent Dwarves died at this site, simply doing their jobs. The vengeance you delivered to those evil creatures should make them think twice before attacking King Magni's subjects ever again.
296-complete.title: Ormer's Revenge

296-progress.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-progress.text: Is Sarltooth dead? Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?
296-progress.title: Ormer's Revenge

299-accept.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-accept.text:
Just before the invasion I uncovered a large tablet called the Goaz Stone. The translated text breaks off in 4 places. The text speaks of a "divine plan" and a "doomed prophecy."

I fear we are running out of time. I am too old to go down and brave those beasts. But you are strong.

Scour the excavation site and uncover the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru. Search for them in ancient artifacts or where the soil is loose. Bring them to me so I can begin unlocking the mystery!
299-accept.title: Uncovering the Past

299-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-complete.text: Ah the Goaz Stone is complete! Fine work, $N. Fine work indeed. Now I can continue with the delicate translation of this Titan script. I can make out new words already! Hmm...it says here, "Old Gods... Chained Beneath the Land." This is the beginning of something epic.
299-complete.title: Uncovering the Past

299-progress.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-progress.text: Have you uncovered the four fragments yet, $N?  Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru...
299-progress.title: Uncovering the Past

305-complete.name: Merrin Rockweaver
305-complete.text: Oh, thank the heavens you are here!
305-complete.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306-accept.name: Merrin Rockweaver
306-accept.text:
It was horrible! We were uncovering some rare artifacts and we began to discover these large bones.

Before we knew what was happening, these Mottled Raptors overwhelmed the dig site. Many lives were lost.

Ormer here -- so brave -- saved the Prospector and me. He defended us as we ran for shelter. Now we are trapped. And our hard work lies in ruin.

Here, take this note back to my sweet Tarrel. It will explain the situation to him.
306-accept.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306-complete.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-complete.text: Such horrible news! At least 3 of them survived. But when will the killing end? I long for the day when King Magni's subjects can live without fear.
306-complete.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306-progress.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-progress.text: Were you able to find Merrin? Did she send word?
306-progress.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

3112-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3112-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Thran. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
3112-accept.title: Simple Memorandum

3112-complete.name: Thran Khorman
3112-complete.text:
Well, seein' how this is your prime directive, or whatever yer callin' it these days, I gave my word I'd do whatever I can to make sure you and yours were ready to take back your home... and that's just what I'm gonna do.

Any time you feel yer ready, come back to good ol' Thran and I'll be happy to share my knowledge wit ya. There's some cost to me trainin' ya, but it won't be too expensive. Good luck.
3112-complete.title: Simple Memorandum

3112-progress.name: Thran Khorman
3112-progress.text:
Ah, well, another memorandum from a $r on a mission... isn't this quaint.

No, no, I ain't teasin' ya, little one. Gotta respect your tenacity, that much is fer sure. I'd be just as peeved if Ironforge was taken by Dark Iron dwarves, so don't be thinkin' I don't feel for your plight...
3112-progress.title: Simple Memorandum

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

464-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
464-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw orc clan was all but destroyed by the end of the Second War, after they lost control of their red dragon pets. The dragons were not very happy with their old masters, and fiercely hunted the Dragonmaws. What few remained fled from Grim Batol and into the Mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation.

Now they've gained strength, and have an encampment northeast of Menethil.

We want you to attack that encampment. Gather and bring me their war banners as proof.
464-accept.title: War Banners

466-accept.name: Pilot Stonegear
466-accept.text:
I heard that a rare ore, incendicite, was found in the Wetlands, in a cave northwest of Algaz Gate.  Incendicite is volatile stuff and hard to use without blowing yourself up, but I'm sure if it's smelted the right way it could make cannon shells that pack a mighty punch!

Get me incendicite ore and I'll find someone brave enough to experiment with it.

Oh, and to extract that ore from a vein you'll need skill in mining.  If you don't have it, then ... bring a friend who does to that cave!
466-accept.title: Search for Incendicite

467-complete.name: Pilot Stonegear
467-complete.text: Hello $N.  You're here about the task I have, eh?  It's good to see a young $r like yourself whose blood burns at the prospect of adventure!
467-complete.title: Stonegear's Search

471-complete.name: James Halloran
471-complete.text:
Hmm... Don't suppose you'd be interested in becoming my apprentice, would you?

Hah! No, I'm just kidding. You're much too old, for one thing. Besides - from the looks of you, it would seem that you have other ambitions in life. Nonetheless, these are some fine skins you've procured, and I'll be able to put them to good use.
471-complete.title: Apprentice's Duties

471-progress.name: James Halloran
471-progress.text:
My apprentice is like a son to me. It's going to be hard for him to live his life with only one leg.

Ah, $N, how goes it?  Do you have my skins?
471-progress.title: Apprentice's Duties

472-accept.name: Harlo Barnaby
472-accept.text:
Dun Modr has fallen to the Dark Iron Dwarves!

My wounds are grave, $c.  Most of the regiment was killed!  The Dark Iron thugs attacked us before we could regroup from the Thandol Span ambush.

Our leader, Longbraid, sounded the retreat horn.  As we left the town I was hit by a stray axe in the back.  All went black.

I awoke here in Menethil but I fear for my fellow soldiers.  Hope still burns within me.  Perhaps Longbraid is still alive!  See if you can find him near Dun Modr, $r!
472-accept.title: Fall of Dun Modr

473-accept.name: Valstag Ironjaw
473-accept.text:
$N.  The Dragonmaw orc clan is showing its strength in more than just Algaz.

Captain Stoutfist has asked to speak with those willing to offer aid against these orcs.  He is inside the keep, in the war room.
473-accept.title: Report to Captain Stoutfist

473-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
473-complete.text:
$N. Valstag briefed me on your past success with the Dragonmaw Orcs at Dun Algaz. You're a $r of worth.

And I have a task for you.
473-complete.title: Report to Captain Stoutfist

536-accept.name: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle
536-accept.text:
Transferred from the Stormwind city guard to Southshore, a town that should be abandoned by the looks of it... Smell of the harbor day and night.

Not to mention ol' Redpath... Wants me to take care of the murlocs. Ha! 

I can barely rouse myself to go out to some of the pockets of the overgrown fish down the Western Strand. If you would go in my place and take care of them, I'd appreciate it.
536-accept.title: Down the Coast

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

7793-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7793-progress.text:
As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7793-progress.title: A Donation of Silk

7807-progress.name: Bubulo Acerbus
7807-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Gnomeregan Exiles for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7807-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

78146-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78146-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78146-complete.title: Goaz Scrolls

78146-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78146-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78146-progress.title: Goaz Scrolls

78148-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78148-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78148-complete.title: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings

78148-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78148-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78148-progress.title: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings

91900-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91900-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91900-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92489-accept.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
92489-accept.text:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489-accept.title: Power Overwhelming

94248-accept.name: Unknown
94248-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Blue Overalls, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94248-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

94248-complete.name: Alyce
94248-complete.text:
The Blue Overalls! Thank goodness, I have a proper change of clothes.

Take this, and please be on your way. I do not have time to chat, I must keep an eye on the farm and can't risk more distractions.
94248-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

94248-progress.name: Alyce
94248-progress.text:
Oh! Please keep your voice down--we don't need to draw any further attention to ourselves.

Do you have something for me?
94248-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

95-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
95-accept.text:
I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!

When I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something.  He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders.  So I never discovered what was hidden.

If you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful.  The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.
95-accept.title: Sven's Revenge

95647-accept.name: Caitlin Grassman
95647-accept.text:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
95647-accept.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

98071-accept.name: Brewmeister Bilger
98071-accept.text:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
98071-accept.title: Brewer's Trade

98071-complete.name: Brewmeister Bilger
98071-complete.text:
That's the hops smell I missed! Ye done me a great favor, $N, takes me days to leave every time I make the trip to Dun Garok myself. Hard to pull me self outta the halls o' that fortress once I get comfortable.

Happy to keep some old tastes on the shelf for fellow dwarves.

Have a little somethin' for helpin out.
98071-complete.title: Brewer's Trade

98071-progress.name: Brewmeister Bilger
98071-progress.text: Lookin' ta try a new ale?
98071-progress.title: Brewer's Trade

98072-accept.name: James Halloran
98072-accept.text:
You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!
98072-accept.title: Crocs of the Sky

98216-accept.name: Prospector Whelgar
98216-accept.text:
Old Gods?! This cannot be good news at all!

I've made out a new bit on the stone that speaks of a guardian of some kind. Whatever it is, it must be linked to the stone!

Take it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens!

If I'm right, you'll activate the thing. Take it out if so, but try to preserve anything interesting! We simply must know more!
98216-accept.title: Understanding Our Present

98216-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
98216-complete.text:
Look there--see how the Goaz Stone starts to glow when near the keystone? I can almost make out some more words...

We still must learn more about this Goaz. I feel like we're just on the tip of the iceberg with something huge!
98216-complete.title: Understanding Our Present

98219-complete.name: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle
98219-complete.text: Ah, of course. Another one of Stormwind's finest here to check on me. Same as last month!
98219-complete.title: The Shamed Lieutenant

98221-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
98221-accept.text:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
98221-accept.title: From the Ashes

98245-accept.name: Howin Kindfeather
98245-accept.text:
I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.

<Howin spits.>

I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.

These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.

The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.

Bring me a handful of the incisors.
98245-accept.title: Razormaw Needling

98246-accept.name: Howin Kindfeather
98246-accept.text:
I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.
98246-accept.title: Trying Times

98310-accept.name: Prospector Whelgar
98310-accept.text:
There are other, larger golems all around the Wetlands. They each bear inscriptions marking them as Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru--matching the missing pieces of the Goaz Stone you found!

I'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone!

You'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.
98310-accept.title: Gleaning Our Future

98459-accept.name: Tom "Half-fish" Wilson
98459-accept.text:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!
98459-accept.title: A Lack of Virtue

98459-complete.name: Bart Tidewater
98459-complete.text:
<Bart unwraps the gift.>

Why that no good, son of a--

Did he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!

I swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--

I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!
98459-complete.title: A Lack of Virtue

98459-progress.name: Bart Tidewater
98459-progress.text:
Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!

Oh? What's that you have there, traveler?
98459-progress.title: A Lack of Virtue

98815-accept.name: James Halloran
98815-accept.text:
The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?

I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.
98815-accept.title: Highland Hides
